title: 🙏 Important Notice — Clock Lock Issue Fix Coming!
message:
Dear Exam Prep Family,

We want to sincerely apologize if you've been experiencing any "Clock Lock" or "Security Lockout" issues while using the app. We understand how frustrating this can be, especially when you're trying to study or access premium features you've paid for.

🔍 What Happened:
Our security system was designed to protect your licenses, but it turned out to be too aggressive. It incorrectly flagged some users for clock manipulation when there was nothing wrong on their end. This is entirely our fault, and we take full responsibility.

🛠 What We're Doing:
We are working around the clock to completely remove this issue and restore your access. A new version of Exam Prep is coming soon with everything fixed!

✅ What The Update Will Include:
• Complete removal of all clock lock and security lockout checks
• Instant access to all premium features you've paid for
• No more "Enable Automatic Time" messages
• Smoother activation process
• All your study progress will be safe

📅 When:
The update will be available very soon. Please keep an eye out for the new version on APKPure or our Telegram channel.

💬 Need Immediate Help?
If you're currently locked out and need access right away, please contact us:
• Telegram: @Kirchhoffandrew
• WhatsApp: 09031144480

We'll verify your payment and restore your access manually within minutes.

Thank you for your patience and for being part of the Exam Prep community. We promise to do better.

— The Exam Prep Team 💚
